baseline_tension: Nothing to set against the lean. The small positive lean (+0.39, mostly short_squeeze on a flat 1.77% short) and the +15.1% 20-day run-up both reflect the Sheffield disposal and the 17 Sep update, which are already public. A non-event day gives neither anything to resolve against.
language_note: The domestic RNS record, not the English wire, is what settles the date. The 14 Jul AGM statement said 'The Group will update on H1 performance in September', and the 10 Sep RNS said 'We will provide a H1 trading update on 17 September 2026'. The September H1 communication was that trading update, not interims. Reuters' copy called the 17 Sep update 'interim profit' and gave no date for full results.

Domestic PDMR filing: NED Tom Handley bought 390,966 shares at 25.45p on 17 Sep 2026, filed 22 Sep. A 30 Sep interim report would put that purchase inside a MAR closed period unless the trading update counted as the preliminary announcement. This supports a later date but does not prove it.
Fidelity UK, a domestic retail platform, lists 'Half yearly results Nov 2026'. That contradicts the 30 Sep date carried by TradingView and Investing.com.
14 Jul AGM result RNS: both special resolutions on disapplying pre-emption failed, with about 36.6% against. This is context on a blocking shareholder minority, not a window item.
